title: Normalized scalar change of a zero-shifted Roos lift
statement: Fix a prime l, finite extensions E,L,F of Q_l with embeddings iota:E to L and j:L to F, and a scheme X. Use the actual completed ordinary and derived scalar functors, universal cochain counits and quotient augmentations [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison], and a normalized SL reduction calculus, Roos models rhoL,rhoF and scalar model b for j [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models, lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Let P be a flat-term K-flat E-complex. Its ordinary scalar extension P' to L is again flat-term K-flat [lem-pur-kflat-change-of-rings-independent]. Let D be any strict L quotient-system complex. Suppose f:P' to Roos(Res_L D) and g:B_j(P') to Roos(Res_F ordinaryScalar_j D) are strict chain maps with zero shifted coordinates. Assume that on every nested sheafified tensor s tensor (t tensor x), the nth unshifted coordinate of g is the quotient of s tensored with the nth unshifted coordinate of f(t tensor x), read through the unchanged restriction-section identification. Then applying derived j-extension to Q(f) followed by the inverse normalized rhoL Roos bridge, then the completion comparison for j, b.realization, the limit of j-extension of the actual SL whole-system counit at Q(D), the limit of the universal system scalar cochain counit at D and the rhoF Roos bridge equals the ordinary scalar counit for j at P' followed by Q(g). No scalar associator or second scalar realization model occurs.

proof.text: Ordinary coefficient extension preserves the good class. Choose a simultaneous strict reduction presentation of P′, and apply b.normalization on it.

Resolve the target tower simultaneously by a K-injective tower. Apply integralConeCounitRealization to the unshifted coordinate family of f. Convert the constant-tower counit to SL.adjunction.counit using integralComparisonReductionCounit_formula. Naturality transports the normalized scalar realization through this adjunct.

The scalar-extended family has exactly g’s tensor coordinates. Balancing and sheafification extend equality from the nested tensor generators. Both shifted coordinates vanish; product and mapping-cocone extensionality give equality before localization. Localize and retain the universal ordinary scalar counit.

theorem scalarModelRoosZeroLift
    (SL : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l L X)
    (ρL : IntegralComparisonRoosModel l L X)
    (ρF : IntegralComparisonRoosModel l F X)
    (b : IntegralComparisonScalarModel l L F j X SL ρF)
    (P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E X).FullSubcategory)
    (D : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l L X) ℤ)
    (f : (completedOrdinaryScalarComplex l E L ι X).obj P.obj ⟶ integralOperationsRoos
      (((coefficientSequenceRestriction l L X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj D).asFunctor)
    (g : (completedOrdinaryScalarComplex l L F j X).obj
      ((completedOrdinaryScalarComplex l E L ι X).obj P.obj) ⟶ integralOperationsRoos
      (((coefficientSequenceRestriction l F X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((integralComparisonSequenceScalarModel l L F j X).E.mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj D)).asFunctor)
    (hf : ∀ i : ℤ, f.f i ≫
      (CochainComplex.mappingCocone.snd (scalarRoosBoundary
        (((coefficientSequenceRestriction l L X).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj D).asFunctor)).v i (i - 1) (by omega) = 0)
    (hg : ∀ i : ℤ, g.f i ≫
      (CochainComplex.mappingCocone.snd (scalarRoosBoundary
        (((coefficientSequenceRestriction l F X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
          (((integralComparisonSequenceScalarModel l L F j X).E.mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ)).obj D)).asFunctor)).v i (i - 1) (by omega) = 0)
    (htensor : ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ) (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ)
      (s : (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l F X).obj.obj U)
      (t : (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l L X).obj.obj U)
      (x : (P.obj.X i).val.obj U) (y : (D.X i).val.obj (op (n, U.unop))),
      ((f.f i ≫ (CochainComplex.mappingCocone.fst (scalarRoosBoundary
        (((coefficientSequenceRestriction l L X).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj D).asFunctor)).f i ≫
        (Pi.π (fun m : ℕ ↦
          (((coefficientSequenceRestriction l L X).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ)).obj D).asFunctor.obj (op m)) n).f i).val.app U)
        (completedScalarTensorSection l E L ι X (P.obj.X i) U t x) =
          integralComparisonRestrictedSection l L X (D.X i) n U y →
      ((g.f i ≫ (CochainComplex.mappingCocone.fst (scalarRoosBoundary
        (((coefficientSequenceRestriction l F X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
          (((integralComparisonSequenceScalarModel l L F j X).E.mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ)).obj D)).asFunctor)).f i ≫
        (Pi.π (fun m : ℕ ↦
          (((coefficientSequenceRestriction l F X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
            (((integralComparisonSequenceScalarModel l L F j X).E.mapHomologicalComplex
              (.up ℤ)).obj D)).asFunctor.obj (op m)) n).f i).val.app U)
        (completedScalarTensorSection l L F j X
          (((completedOrdinaryScalarComplex l E L ι X).obj P.obj).X i) U s
          (completedScalarTensorSection l E L ι X (P.obj.X i) U t x)) =
      integralComparisonRestrictedSection l F X
        ((integralComparisonSequenceScalarModel l L F j X).E.obj (D.X i)) n U
        (integralComparisonSequenceTensorSection l L F j X (D.X i) (op (n, U.unop))
          ((completedIntegralCommRingProjectionUnrestricted l F X n).hom.app U s) y)) :
    (completedDerivedScalarExtension l L F j X).map
        (DerivedCategory.Q.map f ≫ (integralComparisonRoosBridge l L X ρL D).inv) ≫
      (completedScalarComparison l L F j X).app
        ((coefficientSequenceLimit l L X).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj D)) ≫
      b.realization.hom.app
        ((coefficientSequenceLimit l L X).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj D)) ≫
      (coefficientSequenceLimit l F X).map
        ((integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar l L F j X).map
          (SL.adjunction.counit.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj D))) ≫
      (coefficientSequenceLimit l F X).map
        ((integralComparisonSequenceScalarModel l L F j X).ε.app D) ≫
      (integralComparisonRoosBridge l F X ρF _).hom =
    completedScalarCounit l L F j X
      ((completedOrdinaryScalarComplex l E L ι X).obj P.obj) ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map g
